Episode 253: Gathering Once Again in Laprarosa (5)
Beltian’s two massive eyes continued to unleash shockwaves.
The shields of the fleet surrounding the sky were now barely holding on. Jin glanced back and forth between Beltian and Bligiet, then nodded.
“What are you planning to do with that?”
[Just show it to him! I am powerless right now in this restrained state, so you must take me and approach Beltian.]

Taking Bligiet close to Beltian was a dangerous act. In the first place, Bluggiet's sudden change in attitude was also strange. However, Jin decided not to trust Bligiet, but to trust Ameris for this once.
“If it weren't for Lady Ameris, I would have never trusted you.”
[You will come to trust me a lot in the future, mortal Jin Runcandel. As I said, I have decided to bet my everything on you all, so the world will finally become beautiful again.]
Bligiet grabbed Jin’s left arm.

In the next moment, Jin leaped in a single bound and approached Beltian's eyeballs, which had once again taken position in the sky. Naturally, the shockwaves tried to repel Jin more strongly the closer he got, but Vahn and Murakan also protected him.

Lightning, blue flames, aura, and sun energy clashed again, forming a searing current that seemed capable of incinerating anything. Bligiet flinched every time the heat penetrated the shield, getting on Jin's nerves.
[H-hey, block it properly! At this rate, I'm going to burn up before I can even show this to Beltian!]
“Stop whining. You're distracting me.”
[Uh, uh uh, over there, strike over there!]
“Bligiet... were you always like this?”
Although Jin sounded calm, the truth was that the surging power of Beltian had him on edge.
He had to protect Bligiet while moving, which made it worse. One mistake, and he could end up severely injured.

Of course, it wouldn't be a fatal wound, so he could recover, but the battle time would inevitably increase. And an increase in battle time meant that somewhere, innocent people were meeting their deaths at the hands of the Zipples.
He had brought nearly his entire force to avoid seeing that happen. Jin gritted his teeth and swung Bradamante.
Every time Bradamante moved, a massive trajectory was left in the sky, and the sun energy released by Beltian poured down to the ground.
Due to constant explosions and shockwaves, Jin was barely visible. Even Vahn and Murakan couldn’t easily keep up with him.
It was because their vision was blocked. If they recklessly pursued him while randomly slashing at the sun energy, Jin or Bligiet could get hurt.
[Araxion! Unlike me, you are in a whole state, yet why do you only send your energy? Come quickly, Malugia must be waiting for us!]
Beltian's counterattack was also growing fiercer. The sight of him being mercilessly overwhelmed by Jin, Van, and Murakan was gone, and he now revealed a dignity befitting the name of Destruction.
Two eyeballs, and tens of thousands of arms sprouting from them like gears.

Every time those arms moved once, shining spears formed of sun energy were thrown in all directions. The spears eventually pierced the shields of the Golden Fleet and were directly striking the outer armor.
“All units! Focus defenses around the flagship and follow Brother Jin’s orders!”

Even though their armor was being pierced, the fleet did not panic and carried out Jin's orders. Luet, in particular, had already moved to the outskirts of Laprarosa and was tracking Ganesto's records.
[Found them! The location is in the southern part of Lafrarosa, near the city entrance! Ran, Vygo, Myu, and Anne Ganesto are operating a Chaos dimensional gate.]
{The esteemed Veradin and I will go, Head Butler of Runcandel.}
The Hairan First Flagship, the Sword Emperor's Ship, immediately responded to the communication. Dante had been preparing to deploy with Veradin's Tikan 9th Fleet right after the situation unfolded.
[Understood. I will continue to track the records.]
Dante and Veradin's fleets immediately began to land, following the coordinates sent by Luet. In the process, most of the ships were pierced by Beltian's spears, but no ships were shot down.
The outskirts of Laprarosa were the area farthest from Beltian's sun energy on the battlefield, but even so, the sun energy made the entire view shine brightly.
“Veradin and I will land alone. The fleet will form an encirclement so that the enemies cannot escape.”
“Understood, Sir Dante!”
Dante and Veradin landed and took position.
The Ganestos also knew that they had arrived. Among them, Myu and Anne smirked as they saw the two men who had entered through the sun energy.
“Looks like our youngest's bootlickers have arrived.”
“What are you here for? Don't you get it yet? We don't die.”
At those words, Dante and Veradin let out a small laugh.
“This is an era where death has faded anyway, Anne Runcandel. Your annihilation will come when the entire Ganesto clan is finished. But our goal right now isn't to eliminate you lot anyway.”
“That's right. We just need to ruin Rokia's work, that's all.”
Sssreung...!
The Ganestos drew their swords first. And at that moment, Myu belatedly realized that her left arm had already fallen to the floor.
'When in the world... ah, the Formless Sword...!'
A split second after thinking of the Formless Sword, her head fell, and the remaining three hastily scattered, heightening their senses.

However, even if they had awakened the power of Ganesto, they could not read the Formless Sword. Especially in a situation like now where the surroundings were filled with sun energy, making it difficult to distinguish between energies.
“Deal with those vermin, Dante. I’ll destroy the dimensional gate.”
“Got it.”
Fwoom...! Flames erupted from Beradin’s staff.
Annihilation Dark Heaven Flame Prison, Magic Emperor Form 1—the decisive magic of Riol Zipple, which he could now perfectly control, was blooming with his magic power.
“A magic that brings back memories, Lord Veradin.”
“Right? I'm going to make it explode spectacularly enough for Jin to see, so just wait a bit.”
The massive flames of the Annihilation Dark Heaven Flame Prison were already heading for the unnaturally black, shimmering dimensional gate.
The Ganestos had originally planned to buy time by fighting.

'Five minutes, no. If we can just hold on for three more minutes, we can send the rest of Araxion's power. But damn it, this is the gap in power? Even now? And that guy isn't even the youngest, it's Dante Hairan...!'
Shlk! Slash!
The sound of flesh and bone being cut by an invisible sword aura continued second by second.
“It seems you have forgotten, but I am the Sword Emperor. Though I may not yet reach Jin, you trash-like beings should consider it an honor to even cross swords with me.”
Never mind three minutes, even 30 seconds was impossible.

The Ganestos were able to realize this in an instant. Furthermore, Dante wasn't even using his full strength. He was fighting them moderately, so that if they were holding any cards, they would have no choice but to play them.
Hoping that Rokia or Joshua, people like them, would reveal themselves.

Veradin, on the other hand, trusted Dante and was pouring all his magic into the Annihilation Dark Heaven Flame Prison. It was the most fundamental solution to weaken the power of Beltian, who was currently pressuring the Genesis Knights and the coalition fleet.
As the hellfire scorched the Chaos Gate, Jin immediately sensed the shift on the battlefield.
'The Head Butler found the Ganestos. Dante and Veradin are striking them now.'
It was still subtle, but he could feel that the sun energy from Araxion being transmitted to Beltian was weakening.
[Araxion's power is being cut off, what a relief!]
Bligiet sighed in relief as he realized it too.
“I missed hundreds of opportunities to attack Beltian while protecting you. That sun energy of yours had better be worth it.”
[Hmph, it certainly will be.]
“It seems your confidence has suddenly vanished. I hope I'm mistaken.”
[Is there anything absolute in this world, Jin Runcandel? If Beltian doesn't change his mind... still, couldn't you cut me some slack on the interview with Lucy?]
Jin was momentarily speechless.

Still, he was now at a distance where he could soon face Beltian's true form, hidden by the sun energy. As Jin took a risk and began to increase his speed even more, Bligiet squeezed his eyes shut and waited for the breakthrough to end.
As if a closed door was opening, he finally passed through all the sun energy that hid Beltian's true form.
Below the two colossal eyeballs, a being that looked like a person sculpted from gold was crouched. That was Beltian's true form.
[Araxion, Malugia...]
Contrary to how he had been roaring outside, Beltian was crouched within the sun energy, repeating the names of the other egos of Destruction.
Jin created a sword wind to fix his position and poked Bluggiet in the side.
[Beltian.]
[Bliget? You dare—!]
[Wait, wait, wait. Before you get angry, take a look at this first!]
Bliget raised the rainbow-hued sun energy. Beltian, about to lunge, suddenly froze and fixed his eyes on it.
[...The memory of the beginning!? How do you have that.]
[I’ve broken free from my restraints, Beltian. You too, just take one look at this, and you will realize. Why we created this world!]
Hwaaaaa...!
The rainbow-colored sun energy shone brightly and fell before Beltian.
The first memory of the 'whole Sun God,' Kinzelo, was a simple emotion that anyone could easily imagine.

[Beltian, we created the world simply because we were lonely. We couldn't bear the fact that only we existed in the endless, vast emptiness, so we created the land, the sky, and life. But to destroy all of that? It's unthinkable. This sphere is what we left behind when we were whole!]
At Bluggiet's words, Jin was once again so dumbfounded that he was speechless.
“You said ‘just trust me once,’ and this is what you meant? Bligiet. There’s no way this could possibly—"
[Hic... sob...]
The moment Beltian, who had been about to charge at Bligiet, suddenly collapsed and burst into tears, Jin could only blink his eyes in shock.
'...This actually works?'
While he was at a loss for how to react, Bligiet hastily moved close to Jin and whispered in his ear.
‘Jin, strike him now!’
‘What?’

'Unlike me, that one is an ego of Destruction. He's become sentimental for a moment over an old memory, but he is fundamentally an ego of Destruction. So before he comes to his senses, you must quickly cut him down and bind him with restraints like me so he cannot recover. Now is when he is most vulnerable, so cut him down quickly!'
Note:
멸살암천화염옥 - Annihilation Dark Heaven Flame Prison/Cage
I can’t come up with a better translation other than that, if only this novel put hanja (well of course not as the setting wasn’t murim to begin with) this could’ve been resolved.
